n05Conclusion.summary: All nine N05 objectives require a specific mechanism trigger (construction variation; copy/identity choice; incompatible interface; added wrapping policy; uniform leaf/group operations; independent variation axes; intrinsic/extrinsic reuse; or dependency-graph assembly). The 153 visible cases instead describe one-operation business invariants and do not establish those triggers. This is a per-object review of the named lens and facts, not a source marker verdict or approval for a blanket rewrite. Apply identity policy individually after a proposed correction.
